name: The Individualist
tagline: The Romantic or the Tragic Romantic

items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Emotional (Heart center).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Inward: focusing on their own feelings to define their identity.

items.label: Core issue
items.value: Identity (Who am I), personal worth, managing shame.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, ego pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoiding banality or the ordinary at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Envy: a feeling that others have something fundamental that is missing in oneself.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Melancholy (Spleen), sometimes experienced as an aesthetic refinement of suffering.

items.label: Defense mechanisms
items.value: Introjection (absorbing outer affects to feel one exists) and artistic sublimation.

items.label: Ego pride
items.value: I am different, I am sensitive.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Having no real identity or personal significance.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Being themselves: creating a unique identity from inner experience.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Fearlessness / Tenacity (the Sensualist): endures in silence, may take risks to feel alive or deny their vulnerability.

children.label: Social
children.value: Shame (the Outsider): feels unable to fit in, exposes their sensitivity and sadness in order to be accepted.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Competition / Hate: refuses shame through competition and arrogance, wants to be the most special for their partner.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Withdrawn: withdraws to protect their inner world.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Reactive: reacts intensely to losses and demands a strong emotional response.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 3 (more extroverted, image-focused) and wing 5 (more solitary, intellectual, eccentric).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 1: more objective, disciplined, grounded in action, less a slave to moods.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 2: dependent, manipulative, seeks attention through favors or emotional scenes.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Origin: the soul is inseparable from its source, everything emanates from Being.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Equanimity: staying present without being swept away by the waves of imagination.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Essential identity (the Point): a luminous, unique, irreplaceable presence.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Abandonment / Disconnection: feeling like a stranger to reality.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Control: managing one's inner experience to mask the fear of loss.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Separate identity: believing the self is an isolated entity.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner Little 1: felt defective, learned to use drama in order to exist.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Sad stories / Drama: vivid, symbolic, intense language.

items.label: Communication miscommunication
items.value: Authenticity-Affectation: the quest for truth can be perceived as artificial theatrics.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Imagination used heavily to intensify feelings.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Not identifying with feelings, grounding in the present, daily discipline: doing before feeling.

items.label: Frequent mix-ups
items.value: 1 (idealism), 2 (connection), 6 (anxiety), 9 (withdrawal).

children.label: In love
children.value: Intense, push-pull: draws in then pushes away out of fear of being overwhelmed or abandoned.

children.label: At work
children.value: Intuition and creativity, but possible inconsistency depending on inner weather.

levels.text: Inspired creator: authentic, revealing presence, clear depth.
Self-aware and intuitive: fine sensibility, creativity in service of the truth.
Authentic: expresses their uniqueness without dramatizing, grounded in reality.
Imaginative aesthete: seeks intensity, strong emotional coloring.
Capricious exception: hypersensitivity, emotional demands, moodiness.
Alienated depressive: a feeling of lack, withdrawal, helplessness.
Emotionally tormented: amplified pain, instability, despair.
Self-destructive: collapse, self-sabotage, loss of bearings.

items.label: Awareness
items.value: Moving from the trance of subjective emotion to self-remembering.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: Often in tune with GREEN: empathy, respect for human uniqueness.

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A deep-sea diver: brings back treasures of meaning from the depths of human suffering.
